_note: Adventures: everything pets are sent out to do. TYPES just group places (and what they're like); 'gear': false means trips there pack no gear, 'scout': false that they never take scout notes (data/errands.json). LOCATIONS form a branching map: only the one with 'start' is open at first; the rest open when a pet spots them on a trip ('leads_to': { to, spot = chance per trip that comes home }) or when a rumour leads there. 'map' places it on the pet's doodle map (x/y in map units, garden at 0,0; 'doodle' picks the drawing; 'note' is the pet's scribble); 'more': true draws a ? cloud beyond it. 'page' is which map page it's on (data/unlocks.json 'pages'); a place with 'start' is open as soon as its page is. A place has a fixed 'events' list, or a weighted 'pool' that each trip draws 'draws' events from without repeats; 'go_home': true adds a 'go home' option (keep the bag) to every event; 'part_slots' makes parts found there lean to those slots. 'minutes' is the whole trip, 'max_party' caps party size there, 'safe': true means nobody gets hurt or lost there (a failure just brings nothing: the garden, to learn how adventures go), 'difficulty' multiplies option difficulty, 'danger' how many get hurt or lost, 'loot' multiplies coins, 'box' is the box found there and the odds for part rarity; 'finish_rewards' is a treat bag for trips that go all the way (not home early); a treat with 'after' (a find id) only comes once that find is home (the sunset bits wait for the sunset globe). Rewards grow the further into a trip an event is (x1, x1.25, x1.5, ...). EVENTS are shared. Option: 'chance' is its own chance of going well (tilted a little by 'stat' and down if hurt); older options test 'stat' against 'difficulty'; no chance and no stat = always works; 'tag' is for policies; 'min_party' hides it for smaller parties. 'band': the place is a band of the old well dungeon now (data/dungeon.json): never sent to, not on the map (trips already out there still come home). The well caps parties ('max_party'): swarms go down the well line only as the dungeon's army. Outcome: 'lost'/'injured'/'heal' are [min, max] fractions of the party, 'hurt' is a fraction of pets that lose a heart ('hearts': 2 = both at once; a pet hurt twice doesn't come back, and nothing it found comes home), 'progress' is continue / end / skip, 'leave_injured' leaves the injured behind, 'text_no_parts' is said instead of 'text' on trips that set off before parts are in the game (their part rewards stay out too); 'rewards' is a list of { kind, ... } handled in scripts/adventure/rewards.gd (coins: 'amount' per pet; box/part/rumour/anything else: 'chance', growing with the square root of the party). RUMOURS are what exploring brings back: 'about' is how the pet describes it, 'unlocks' what saying yes opens, 'requires' what must be open before anyone can hear it; 'retired': true is never heard any more (its place became a dungeon band). An event with 'find' gives a special item once (see data/unlocks.json): it stops turning up after it's been found; finds are 'auto': true (no question: the party does the first option by itself and walks on; a failed try just means it turns up again on a later trip); an event's 'min_party' skips it for smaller parties; '{i}' is 'i' for one pet, 'we' for a party; 'after' (a find id) keeps it away until that find is home; 'after_machine' (a node id on data/machine_tree.json) keeps it away until that node is fixed (the basket waits for the flap, so errands open once bits start holding the machine up); 'after_workers' (a number) keeps it away until you have that many workers in the automation tab, all jobs added up (the whistle). 'after_sent' (a number) keeps it away until that many pets have been sent to its place before, every party ever sent there added up (GameState.sent; the rope at the well: the next party once ~100 have gone down). {who} is the pet's name, or 'the party'. Texts stay cheerful and plain. NEXT DOOR (page next_door): 'lights' is how many visits until a place is ours (one light goes out per trip welcomed back); 'ours_at_start' places are ours as soon as the page opens (so their written danger/loot always meet the ours numbers, their locals never show: keep 'local' events and 'trace' off them); 'risky' tags the card; 'map' on the street is 'x' = the garden's column (0 on the left) and 'y' 1 = in our fence (the gate), 'trace' = the locals' trace drawn in the garden. OURS: once next door is open ('opens_with'), a place with no lights becomes ours after its page's 'ours_after' visits (data/unlocks.json pages); an ours trip has 'danger' and 'loot' multiplied, and events with 'local': true (the locals' traces) stop turning up there. 'say_dark' is what your pet says when a light goes out on a trip you sent, 'say_ours' when a place becomes ours ({place} is its name).

types.name: foraging
types.desc: little adventures for snacks and shiny things

types.name: exploring
types.desc: going further to see what's out there

ours.say_dark: shh... the house behind {place} is going to bed.

rumours.title: an orchard
rumours.about: an orchard full of apples over the hill

rumours.title: a deep well
rumours.about: a really deep well behind the shed

rumours.title: a little door
rumours.about: a little door at the bottom of the old well

rumours.title: stairs going down
rumours.about: some stairs that go further down than anyone's been

rumours.title: where the map stops
rumours.about: a spot past the orchard where the map just stops

events.title: the rope goes on
events.text: so many of us have been down the well now that we know every stone. and the old rope doesn't stop at the bottom: it goes further down, into the dark.

success.text: we followed the rope down past the bottom! it goes further down than anyone's been. we tied a bow on it so we can find it again ♡

events.title: a little basket
events.text: a little basket sits all alone in the grass. perfect for carrying things!

success.text: {i} found a little basket! bringing it home ♡

events.title: an old cart
events.text: under the leaves at the far end of the woods: an old cart! it still rolls, but it's stuck in the mud.

success.text: {i} found an old cart and pulled it out of the mud! bringing it home ♡

failure.text: {i} found an old cart, but it's stuck in the mud. next time!

events.title: a wheelbarrow
events.text: leaning on the orchard fence: a wheelbarrow with one squeaky wheel. it's big enough for a few friends!

success.text: {i} found a wheelbarrow! wheeling it home. squeak, squeak!

events.title: a hay wagon
events.text: a big old hay wagon at the edge of the meadow, still half full of hay. it's so big!

success.text: we found a hay wagon! everyone pushed at once and it rolled all the way home ♡

failure.text: we found a hay wagon, but it wouldn't budge. maybe with more friends?

events.title: a piggy bank
events.text: tucked in the roots of the oldest apple tree: a little piggy bank. it jingles!

success.text: {i} found a piggy bank! carrying it home. jingle jingle!

events.title: a tiny whistle
events.text: hanging on a nail inside the old well: a tiny tin whistle on a string. it's still shiny!

success.text: {i} found a tiny whistle! tweeeet! everyone looked up.

events.title: a tiny capsule machine
events.text: in the long grass: a capsule machine, just pet-sized. its glass is cracked and its crank is bent. nobody's using it.

success.text: {i} found a tiny capsule machine! rolling it home. it rattles!

events.title: a big glass globe
events.text: half hidden in the long grass: a big glass globe on a rusty stand, the colour of a sunset. leaves are sticking out of the top.

success.text: {i} found a sunset globe! rolling it home very, very carefully.

events.title: a comfy cushion
events.text: a big comfy cushion, lying in the grass like it's waiting for someone.

success.text: {i} found a comfy cushion! dragging it all the way home ♡

events.title: butterflies
events.text: a cloud of butterflies! one of them has shiny wings.

success.text: so pretty! {who} feels lovely.
{who} caught up! it left a sparkly something!

events.title: a hay bale
events.text: a big soft hay bale. something jingles inside it.

success.text: hay everywhere! so comfy!
{who} found a little pouch!

failure.text: it was a very pokey jingle!

events.title: mole hills
events.text: lots of little mole hills! someone is digging down there.

success.text: the moles shared their treasure!
hop! hop! hop!

events.title: a lost kite
events.text: a kite is stuck way up in the only tree in the meadow.

success.text: it looks happy up there!
{who} got the kite! it had a ribbon tied on!

options.label: jump for it from the top

success.text: {who} flew with the kite! amazing!

events.title: mushrooms
events.text: a ring of mushrooms. some of them glow a little.

success.text: better not step inside!
it glows in {who}'s bag now!

events.title: an owl
events.text: an owl blinks from a branch. there's something shiny in its nest.

success.text: hoo! the owl dropped a coin!
{who} grabbed the shiny thing!

events.title: a hollow log
events.text: a big hollow log. it echoes when you say hi!

success.text: {who} found things people dropped in there!
hi! hi! hi! (echo)

events.title: a fox
events.text: a fox is watching from the ferns. it looks hungry.

success.text: {who} was very, very quiet!
the fox left a present!

failure.text: the fox wanted more than a snack!

events.title: a frog
events.text: a frog on a rock! it looks like it wants to race.

success.text: {who} won! the frog gave up its lucky pebble!
ribbit!

events.title: lily pads
events.text: lily pads all the way to a little island!

success.text: the island waved back!
{who} made it! the island had treasure!

failure.text: one pad was a bit wobbly!

events.title: rustling reeds
events.text: the reeds are rustling. something's hiding in there!

success.text: a family of ducklings! they had a gift!

failure.text: it was a very grumpy heron!

success.text: shh, someone's napping!

events.title: a turtle
events.text: a big old turtle is sunbathing. it looks very wise.

success.text: a quiet little rest. {who} feels better!
the turtle knew a secret spot!

failure.text: the turtle went for a very deep swim!

events.title: stepping stones
events.text: stepping stones across the stream. some look slippery.

success.text: hop hop hop! something shiny on the other side!
nice and dry!

events.title: a big fish
events.text: a big fish is swimming against the current!

success.text: go fish, go!
{who} caught it! it coughed up a coin purse!

failure.text: the fish pulled {who} for a swim!

events.title: a bottle
events.text: a little bottle floats by. there's a note inside!

success.text: the note is a map! and a little gift!
bye bye bottle!

events.title: a waterfall
events.text: a little waterfall. there's a sparkle behind it!

success.text: so refreshing! {who} feels great!
a secret cave full of sparkles!

failure.text: the water was very, very strong!

events.title: old boxes
events.text: a tower of dusty old boxes. one says 'keep out'.

success.text: dust and a coin!
{who} found somebody's old dress-up things!

events.title: a big spider
events.text: a big spider is sitting in the doorway. it has lots of legs.

success.text: {who} held their breath all the way!
shoo! it left its web full of shiny bits!

failure.text: the spider did not want to shoo!

events.title: a jar of buttons
events.text: a big jar of buttons on a high shelf!

success.text: buttons! so round!
buttons everywhere! and something special!

failure.text: the jar was heavier than it looked!

events.title: a mouse family
events.text: a family of mice lives in an old boot!

success.text: the mice made {who} a tiny cup of tea!
{who} borrowed it! it had a ring inside!

events.title: a fork in the path
events.text: one way smells of flowers. the other way is dark and twisty!

success.text: {who} sniffed every flower!
{who} found something shiny round the bend!

events.title: brambles
events.text: thorny brambles! and something red and shiny right in the middle.

success.text: the long way round!
{who} grabbed it! not a scratch!

events.title: a big goose
events.text: a goose stands in the way. it is very big!

success.text: {who} tiptoed right past!
{who} chased the goose off! it dropped something!

failure.text: the goose was very good at chasing back!

events.title: a little chest
events.text: a little chest sits by the path. it's humming to itself.

success.text: treasure! {who} found a part!

failure.text: it was a tiny mimic! it was very excited!

success.text: maybe next time!

events.title: an apple tree
events.text: apples! and one golden apple right at the very top.

success.text: crunchy!
{who} got the golden apple!

events.title: a bee hive
events.text: a hive is buzzing away in a tree. honey drips down!

success.text: bzz bzz! bye bees!
{who} got sticky paws and a pocket of honey!
{who} carried off the whole hive! wow!

failure.text: the bees were very, very excited!

events.title: a lost ball
events.text: a bouncy ball, all alone in the grass.

success.text: boing boing! {who} feels all better!
a ball for later!

events.title: a duck pond
events.text: ducks! and something sparkly at the bottom of the pond.

success.text: quack!
{who} came up with something sparkly!

events.title: a fork in the path
events.text: the path splits in two!

success.text: {who} found a patch of sweet clover!
{who} found something shiny in the hedge!

failure.text: the hedge was extra scratchy today!

events.title: brambles
events.text: thorny brambles cover the path.

success.text: {who} slipped through without a scratch!
{who} pushed straight through!

events.title: a big goose
events.text: a goose stands in the way. it is very big!

success.text: {who} chased the goose off! it dropped something!

failure.text: the goose was very good at fighting!

success.text: {who} tiptoed right past!
{who} decided that was enough adventure for today!

events.title: sore paws
events.text: some paws are a bit sore.

success.text: a little rest! everyone feels better!
onwards!
the others will catch up later!

events.title: a little chest
events.text: a little chest sits by the path, unlocked!

success.text: treasure! {who} found a part!

failure.text: it was a tiny mimic! it was very excited!

success.text: maybe next time!

events.title: a big puddle
events.text: a big muddy puddle!

success.text: splash-free!
the long way round is nice too!

events.title: a fox
events.text: a fox is watching from the trees!

success.text: the fox ran off! it left a present!
nobody made a peep!

failure.text: the fox found some new friends!

events.title: a big hill
events.text: you can probably see a long way from the top!

success.text: what a view! {who} spotted something far away!
a nice long walk!

events.title: funny tracks
events.text: little tracks lead off the path!

success.text: they led somewhere new!

failure.text: the tracks went round in circles!

success.text: paths are there for a reason!

events.title: an old signpost
events.text: the writing is very faded.

success.text: {who} worked it out! it points somewhere!
signs are boring anyway!

events.title: it's dark
events.text: it's very dark down here!

success.text: eyes adjust! there's stuff everywhere!

failure.text: a few went exploring on their own!

success.text: back into the sunshine!

events.title: an old rope
events.text: a rope goes further down!

success.text: everyone made it down!

failure.text: the rope was a bit wobbly!

success.text: {who} waited by the rope. what a nice rest!

events.title: a small door
events.text: someone is knocking on the other side!

success.text: nobody there! just some coins!

failure.text: someone was home! they love visitors!

success.text: a present was slipped under the door!

events.title: something big
events.text: something big is sleeping here!

success.text: it stayed asleep! so much loot!

failure.text: it woke up and wanted to play!

success.text: shhh!

events.title: a squeaky latch
events.text: their gate has a latch that squeaks if you even look at it.

success.text: not one squeak! {who} slipped right through.

failure.text: SQUEAK! everyone froze. then kept going, extra quietly.

success.text: {who} wriggled under! a coin was stuck in the mud there.

failure.text: a bit of a tight fit. {who} got a muddy tummy.

events.title: a hedgehog
events.text: a hedgehog snuffles along the fence, looking for a midnight snack.

success.text: the hedgehog shared back! it had found a shiny button.
it knew a secret hole in the hedge, full of dropped coins!

events.title: moths round a lamp
events.text: a garden lamp is on, and moths are dancing round it.

success.text: the moths waved. probably.
what a dance! something sparkly fell off the lamp.

failure.text: {who} got dizzy and bumped the lamp.

events.title: a sprinkler
events.text: tick tick tick... a sprinkler comes on in the dark!

success.text: wheee! and a coin was sitting in the puddle.
tick tick tick... done. everyone stayed dry.

events.title: a garden gnome
events.text: a garden gnome with a fishing rod. it has been fishing all night.

success.text: {who} caught something! a little bag of coins.

failure.text: the gnome wobbled! everyone froze until it stopped.

success.text: the gnome didn't wave back. rude. but it was sitting on a coin.

events.title: sleepy tomatoes
events.text: rows of tomatoes, all asleep. one of them is very, very red.

success.text: shh. {who} tucked a leaf over them.
got it! it had a shiny seed inside.

events.title: a warm lamp
events.text: a little lamp keeps the seedlings warm. it's so cosy in here.

success.text: toasty paws! everyone feels better.
under the pots: coins and a button!

events.title: a frog on a lily pad
events.text: a frog on a lily pad. it looks very sure of itself.

success.text: ribbit. that means goodnight.
{who} won! the frog gave up its lucky pebble.

events.title: glowing fish
events.text: orange fish glow under the water. something shiny is down there too.

success.text: so pretty. {who} found a coin on the edge.
{who} came up with a handful of coins!

failure.text: brr! the water was so cold.

events.title: a broken capsule machine
events.text: a capsule machine on the porch, all rusty. its crank is stuck and its glass is foggy.

success.text: there are still capsules inside! and a coin in the slot.
it turned! one old capsule rolled out, full of coins.

failure.text: clunk. it didn't budge, and {who} squished a paw.

events.title: a row of boots
events.text: a row of big boots by the door. perfect for hiding in.

success.text: seven boots. one is lonely.
a whole sock full of coins!

failure.text: phew, what a smell! {who} needs a lie down.

events.title: a long chain
events.text: a long, long chain goes into the doghouse. it jingles.

success.text: the long way round. very sensible.
at the end of the chain: a pile of shiny tags and coins!

failure.text: the chain jingled! a few friends ran off and got lost.

events.title: a buried bone
events.text: the ground is all dug up. there's a bone as big as us!

success.text: it's somebody's bone. we left it.
under the bone: a buried tin of coins!

failure.text: the hole caved in! everyone got very muddy.

events.title: a slipper
events.text: a fluffy slipper at the bottom of the porch steps. just the one.

success.text: someone will want that back.
so fluffy! a coin fell out of the toe.

events.title: a watering can
events.text: a watering can, still dripping. someone was just here.

success.text: shh... on we go.
a perfect hiding spot! and a coin at the bottom.

events.title: a teacup
events.text: a teacup on the edge of the pond. it's still warm.

success.text: {who} didn't want to be there when they come back for it.
chamomile! everyone feels cosy.

events.title: yesterday's paper
events.text: a newspaper on the porch step, open at the puzzles.

success.text: {who} got every word! there was a coupon for coins.

failure.text: the paper rustled so loudly! everyone ran.

success.text: they're halfway through. it's only fair.

events.title: a light clicks on
events.text: a window lights up! somebody's still awake in there.

success.text: click. it went dark again. phew!
{who} made it! and found a coin in the shadows.

events.title: a very big bowl
events.text: a very big bowl. and a very big blanket in the doghouse, going up and down.

success.text: past the bowl! there were coins in the bottom.

failure.text: the blanket rolled over! everyone scattered.

success.text: under the blanket: a hoard of shiny things!

failure.text: the blanket woke up! a few friends ran the wrong way.

events.title: a big snore
events.text: a big, deep snore comes out of the doghouse. the ground shakes a little.

success.text: shh... it's still asleep. a coin rolled out with the snore.

failure.text: {who} sneezed! everyone hid under the bowl.

success.text: zoom! past the doghouse and onto a pile of coins.

failure.text: the snoring stopped! a friend ran off into the dark.
